confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Naha prices. The price searches found no Naha-specific figures for draft beer in a restaurant, cappuccino, cocktail or wine. They did find a Naha 'nice meal' of about $16 per person, a mid-range dinner for two of about $31, a 2022 supermarket beer at about ¥245 per 0.5 L, and Naha restaurants about 7% above the Japan average. Those figures are partial, dated or look low, so the food and drink anchors lean on my general knowledge of Japanese prices, adjusted for Naha. Cocktail and wine are set relative to an assumed izakaya draft beer price of about ¥600, with cocktails around 1.3x beer and wine around 1.2x beer. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Naha accommodation is seasonal, and July is peak season, so those anchors carry wide uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other regional Japanese tourist cities such as Fukuoka or Kagoshima, adjusted modestly upward for Okinawa island-resort demand. Searches indicated Naha is roughly 7-20% above the Japan average.
